description: List defect and maintenance tickets, newest first, capped at about 500 (`truncated` when cut; filters narrow it). Filters: itemId, statuses (open, in_progress, done, wontfix; "open tickets" usually means open + in_progress), type, and a text search over title and description. Every row carries `createdAt` (when the problem was reported, the sort key) and `reporterName` (absent when nobody reported it: a maintenance plan created it, or it came from a logged-out QR report). Dates come twice, the epoch and its ISO twin: `createdAtIso` / `closedAtIso` are UTC instants, `dueAtIso` is a plain calendar day; the server does no timezone conversion. A ticket has no printed code: `webUrl` is its page in the web app and `id` the handle for update_ticket, add_comment and list_comments. The rows are the tickets the connected user sees in the app.

search.description: Text search over ticket title and description

statuses.description: Only these statuses — "open tickets" usually means ["open", "in_progress"]

closedAtIso.description: The same moment as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp

dueAtIso.description: The due date as a plain calendar day, "YYYY-MM-DD". A DAY, not a moment: the server does no timezone conversion
